name: org.liquidplatform/liquid-cybersecurity
title: Liquid Cybersecurity
description: Read-only security guides, sandbox limits, and ownership-gated SPF/DMARC checks for AI-built apps.

tools.name: liquid_get_methodology
tools.description: Read how Liquid assessments record coverage, limitations and retests. Returns the selected section, a short summary and the official methodology URL. Use for methodology questions, not assessment results; this tool does not test a target.

section.description: Topic to read: overview (default) explains evidence-based assessments; coverage lists assessed layers; limits explains scope and missing evidence; retest explains how fixes are verified.

tools.name: liquid_get_public_guide
tools.description: Read a published security guide by its exact slug. Returns a title, short answer and official guide URL, or status not_published for unknown slugs. Use for practical security guidance; it does not inspect code or run checks.

slug.description: Exact guide slug, without a URL or /guides/ prefix. Published choices: free-website-security-check-https-headers-spf-dmarc, vite-environment-variables-are-public, check-supabase-row-level-security-before-launch, vibe-coding-security-checklist-before-launch. Unknown slugs return not_published.

tools.name: liquid_get_sandbox_limits
tools.description: Read the separate browser sandbox limits: maximum UTF-8 input bytes, supported languages, rule count, coverage limitations and sandbox URL. Takes no arguments and does not submit or analyze code.

tools.name: liquid_start_domain_check
tools.description: Check SPF/DMARC for a hostname the user controls. Issue a DNS TXT or HTTPS challenge, publish its proof, then verify with the matching kind and challenge_id. Returns a new check_id and private status_token for liquid_get_check_status. Writes proof/check metadata; no pentest or credit spending. Proof is single-use: do not automatically retry a lost verification response.

domain.description: Exact public hostname the user controls, for example example.com. No scheme, path, port, credentials, IP address, wildcard or trailing dot. Proof is bound to this hostname; parent and subdomain proofs are not interchangeable.

kind.description: Request a new ownership challenge; this step does not run the DNS check.

method.description: Proof delivery method: dns_txt publishes the returned TXT name/value; http_well_known publishes the returned body at the exact HTTPS URL. Use the method the user can publish.

kind.description: Verify the previously issued DNS TXT challenge.

challenge_id.description: UUID from challenge.challenge_id in the issue response for the same hostname and method. Publish the exact returned proof before verification; the challenge expires after 30 minutes and can be used once.

kind.description: Verify the previously issued HTTPS well-known challenge.

challenge_id.description: UUID from challenge.challenge_id in the issue response for the same hostname and method. Publish the exact returned proof before verification; the challenge expires after 30 minutes and can be used once.

ownership_proof.description: Two-step ownership flow: issue a challenge, publish the returned proof, then verify using the matching kind and challenge_id. Do not substitute another host or reuse a consumed challenge.

tools.name: liquid_get_check_status
tools.description: Read a completed domain check using the result check_id and private status_token returned by successful liquid_start_domain_check verification. Returns status and SPF/DMARC states (missing, review, present or inconclusive). Does not run a new check. Missing, expired or incorrect credentials return not_found; never invent or expose the token.

check_id.description: Result check_id returned by successful proof verification, not the earlier challenge check_id. Identifies the stored SPF/DMARC check.

status_token.description: Private bearer token returned once alongside the result check_id by successful verification. Send it only to this Liquid status tool; do not publish, log, guess or request another user's token. Lost tokens cannot be recovered.
